intro: This unit is about one family. It starts with Abraham and Sarah. It ends with Joseph in Egypt. Genesis, the first book of the Bible, tells these stories. Jews, Christians and Muslims all tell stories about this family.
You will meet a promise under the stars. You will meet twins who fought and made up. You will meet a boy with a special coat. And you will see what happens when he chooses to forgive.
By the end, you will be able to say who is in the family. You will draw a family tree. And you will be able to say what the story says a promise and forgiving can do.
bigQuestion: What holds a family together in the stories of Genesis?

timeline.t: Abraham and Sarah leave home for a new land, the story says
A promise under the stars: a family too big to count
Isaac is born, and Sarah laughs
Rebekah gives water to ten camels and marries Isaac
Twins Jacob and Esau fight, and years later they make up
Jacob dreams of a ladder to the sky
Jacob has twelve sons; Joseph gets a special coat
The brothers sell Joseph, and he is taken to Egypt
Joseph explains Pharaoh's dreams and stores up grain
The brothers come for food, and Joseph forgives them

words.d: the first book of the Bible; it tells the story of Abraham's family
saying you will do something, and then doing it
the son of Abraham and Sarah; his name sounds like laughing
two children born to the same mother on the same day
a drawing that shows parents, children and grandchildren
wanting what someone else has, and feeling upset about it
the name for the king of Egypt
to let go of being angry at someone who was unkind to you

test.q: Which book tells the stories of Abraham and Joseph?
test.why: Genesis, the first book of the Bible, tells about Abraham's family.

test.q: What did the story say Abraham's family would be as many as?
test.why: Genesis 15 says God told Abraham his family would be as many as the stars.
Sarah was Abraham's wife and Isaac's mother.
Isaac and Rebekah's twin sons were Esau and Jacob.

test.q: What did Jacob see in his dream at Bethel?
test.why: Genesis 28 says Jacob dreamed of a ladder to the sky with angels on it.

test.q: What new name did the story say Jacob got?
test.why: Genesis 35 says God gave Jacob the name Israel.

choices: Their father gave Joseph a special coat
test.why: Jacob loved Joseph most and gave him a special coat. The brothers wanted one too.
Joseph told Pharaoh the dreams meant seven good years, then seven hungry years.

choices: To let go of being angry
test.why: To forgive is to let go of being angry at someone who was unkind.

test.q: Who said, 'You meant it for bad, but God meant it for good', in the story?
test.why: Genesis 50 says Joseph said this to his brothers when he forgave them.

write.prompt: Pick one person from this unit: Abraham, Sarah, Rebekah, Jacob, Esau or Joseph. Tell one thing the story says they did. Say which part of Genesis it is in. Then tell what you think about it.
tips: Start with 'The story says' or 'Genesis tells'.
Say the name of the person and one thing they did.
Use a word from the word list, like promise or forgive.
Draw a picture to go with your writing.
